calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.calendar_month,
  s.region,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
GROUP BY d.calendar_month, s.region
ORDER BY d.calendar_month, s.region

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 8 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.calendar_month = 9 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS september_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.region) AS distinct_regions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_id) AS distinct_stores,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_gross_amounts
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
  AND s.store_id NOT IN (900, 999)

SELECT 
  channel_code,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count,
  SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gross_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_year = 2024 
  AND d.calendar_month IN (8, 9)
GROUP BY channel_code
